case_name: Poster or flyer with exact details
title: Community Picnic With Complete Details
tests: Checks that a finished flyer preserves the supplied date, time and venue exactly without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A cheerful, polished 4:5 picnic flyer with illustrated flowers, all requested wording clearly legible, and no extra text.

must_haves.item: One portrait 4:5 flyer with cheerful illustrated flowers.
must_haves.why: The portrait flyer has a 4:5 aspect ratio and colorful illustrated flowers framing a cream background.
The large headline reads 'Community Picnic' across two lines.
The date is clearly printed as '12 June 2027'.
The time reads '12:00–15:00' with an en dash.

must_haves.item: The venue reads exactly 'Maple Park, East Gate', and all text is legible and uncropped.
must_haves.why: The venue matches exactly, and all lettering is readable and fully within the flyer.
Only the four requested text elements are visible.
